title: Three Summers and One Short Net
subtitle: 环境保护 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 环境保护（人与自然·环境保护·环境问题与保护）
meta: 主题语境：环境保护（人与自然·环境保护·环境问题与保护）　|　核心词汇：insect　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 insect 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1997 the farmer ① studied the insect that no child in the field would have recorded, and he said the studying was the whole of the week. The ② insect, meaning the creature itself and not the net, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a insect, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ insect in that field had the same short net beside it, and the ④ insect at the far branch, meaning the sample they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A insect, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the farmer said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the insect was the whole of the matter, meaning the sign and not the creature. The ⑥ insect, meaning the sign and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; insect, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both a creature and a sign. He said the sign is the part they remember.

By 2002 the ⑦ insect had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short net. The ⑧ insect of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in June, was one field and three weeks of recording; insect, he said, is either the sample at the far branch or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ insect I remember is the creature recorded in the journal, which closed in 2004 and is still recorded as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ insect, my mother said in 2006, is the only creature that improves by being recorded; every insect, she said, is a sign that has agreed to look like a creature. She said the sign was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 昆虫；虫（指田地里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 昆虫；虫（指那只小虫本身，与网兜相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the insect 研究这种昆虫
D. n. 昆虫；虫（指留给孩子们留的那一只那一只）
E. n. 生态之事（抽象总称，指一处田地的昆虫之事）
F. n. 昆虫；虫（指日志里写到、被记下的的那一只）
G. n. 信号、征兆（指一件事里人人都捉却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 征兆（抽象总称，指人人都捉却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: studied the insect that no child in the field would have recorded
The insect, meaning the creature itself and not the net
the insect at the far branch
the insect was the whole of the matter
the insect had become a line in a journal
The insect of the whole thing
A insect, my mother said in 2006

answers.why: study the insect 意为“研究这种昆虫”，1997 年那位农夫把田地里没有一位孩子肯记录的一只昆虫做了一遍。
insect 意为“昆虫；虫”，指那只小虫本身而不是网兜，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记录。
insect 意为“昆虫；虫”，指田地里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一个小小的网兜。
insect 意为“昆虫；虫”，指最远那根枝头留给孩子们留的那一只那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
insect 意为“信号、征兆”，指一件事里人人都捉却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个信号就是那件事的全部。
insect 意为“征兆”，指人人都捉却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只小虫，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
insect 意为“昆虫；虫”，指日志里写到、被记下的的那一只，到 2002 年这一只成了日志里的一行。
insect 意为“生态之事”，农夫六月写道，整件事的昆虫之事是一处田地和三个星期的记录。
insect 意为“昆虫；虫”，我记得的是日志里记录过的那一只，2004 年记全了，至今仍被说成田地里最安静的一只。
insect 为抽象总称，母亲 2006 年说，昆虫是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的小虫。
